title: A cultural stroll through Paris with actor Michel Boujenah and Lilly Wood & the Prick
summary: This week on Paris des Arts, Valérie Fayolle sits down with actor and comedian Michel Boujenah. He's currently starring in "Toute la famille que j'aime" ("The whole family I love"), a witty comedy at the Théâtre des Variétés.
